title: Gamma-Gamma Spend Models with Covariates
text: GammaGammaCov implements gamma-gamma model spend per transaction time-varying time-invariant covariates, following methodology Fader Hardie (2024).

title: Gamma-Gamma Spend Models with Covariates
text: Install released version CRAN: install development version GitHub:
code: install.packages("GammaGammaCov") # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("kaloklee/GammaGammaCov")

title: Gamma-Gamma Spend Models with Covariates
text: Data transaction (long) format: one row per transaction, customer identifier, amount spent, covariate values effect time transaction. demonstrate estimation using spend_data_sample, small simulated dataset included rapid experimentation testing:
code: library(GammaGammaCov)  # Load the quick-start sample dataset spend_data_sample <- GammaGammaCov::spend_data_sample  # Estimate the spend model with dynamic covariates fit <- GGcov_MLE(   Price ~ discount + gender + channel,   data    = spend_data_sample,   subject = "Id" )  # Print parameter estimates, standard errors, and Wald confidence intervals print(fit)  # Plot the distribution of the baseline spending rate across customers GGcov_plot_mixing(fit)

what: 2. Expected Spend on a Future Transaction
title: Gamma-Gamma Spend Models with Covariates
text: GGcov_expected_spend() returns posterior conditional expectation monetary value future transaction, given customer’s history covariate values transaction (assumed known). predict customer’s next transaction 10% discount:
code: # Each customer's gender and channel, taken from their last observed row last_rows <- spend_data_sample[!duplicated(spend_data_sample$Id, fromLast = TRUE), ] future <- last_rows[, c("Id", "discount", "gender", "channel")] future$discount <- 0.1  GGcov_expected_spend(fit, newdata = future, history = spend_data_sample)

title: Expected Spend per Transaction — GGcov_expected_spend
text: $$E(Z_k \mid \cdot) = \frac{p \, (\gamma + B(x))}{p x + q - 1}   e^{w_k \beta'}, \qquad B(x) = \sum_{=1}^{x} z_i e^{-w_i \beta'},$$ requires \(p x + q > 1\) (Fader Hardie, 2024). One formula covers cases: time-varying covariates: past future transaction     covariate values; static covariates: repeat customer's values every row,     B(x) reduces total spend times \(e^{-w\beta'}\); past transactions (x = 0, customer absent     history): B(x) = 0, giving prior expectation     \(p \gamma e^{w_k\beta'} / (q - 1)\), requires q > 1; model without covariates: \(e^{w_k\beta'} = 1\).

title: GammaGammaCov 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN release. Added GGcov_MLE() maximum likelihood estimation gamma-gamma spend model time-varying, static, covariates (Fader Hardie, 2024). Added GGcov_expected_spend() compute posterior conditional expectation future transaction spend given customer’s transaction history future covariate values. Added GGcov_plot_mixing() plot gamma mixing distribution baseline spending rate across customers. Added GGcov_plot_avg_spend() compare observed versus model-implied distributions customer average spend per transaction. Included simulated transaction datasets spend_data (1,000 customers) spend_data_sample (300 customers), along introductory vignette.
